name: Ripple
description: A glowing, rippling distortion transition that dissolves one photo into another. Raw WebGL, a single fragment shader, and GSAP driving the progress — all tunable live from a floating control panel. A fresh GLSL/WebGL reimplementation of Minsang's 'Ripple with Noise' Metal shader.

best.title: Live demo
best.note: Tap anywhere to send a rippling wavefront across the image.

best.title: Source
best.note: React + TypeScript + Vite, raw WebGL fragment shader, GSAP.
